SE.near: physical RIGHT (kicker) side is toward camera; kicking leg swings across the FRONT
SE.occl: kicking boot may occlude lower support shin at/after CONTACT; keep both continuous

S.near: kicking leg drives straight toward camera — heavy FORESHORTENING of R thigh→shin; boot large & frontal
S.occl: R thigh partly hides pelvis; R boot may overlap L support shin; NO gap at knee

SW.near: body turned down-left; R kicking leg is far-front, crosses toward SW
SW.occl: support (L) leg is nearer camera; R boot passes behind/over ball; preserve R knee bend

NW.near: back view: physical RIGHT = SCREEN RIGHT; kicking leg swings away from camera
NW.occl: R leg largely BEHIND torso; sole/heel of boot faces camera; expect partial occlusion — allowed

N.near: kicking leg drives AWAY — R thigh→shin foreshortened behind body; sole/heel visible
N.occl: R leg mostly occluded by torso until extension; show heel/sole, not laces face; do NOT invent a front-facing boot

NE.near: back view turned right; R kicking leg on screen-right swinging up-and-away
NE.occl: R boot heel toward camera; partial torso occlusion of thigh; keep knee lead readable
